svg.title: Evidence-linked data, local and long-form tasks, and a compact baseline
svg.desc: Native vector master. All labels are editable Times New Roman text. Waveforms, poses, and score snippets are schematic illustrations, not measurements or experimental results.

g.text: “The left arm rises as the knees bend.”

Media and authored text illustrate the record format.
Our baseline: trained expert + stateful harness
